description: Use this when the person asks to move a session to another day or time. Give its sessionId and the new start and end as ISO times. Comes back with an Undo. Do not use to skip a session; use update_session.

end.description: The new end, an ISO date-time.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

sessionId.description: The session's id, from get_today or get_schedule.

start.description: The new start, an ISO date-time.

name: move_session
title: Move a session
